## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change (a bug fix includes a test that fails without the fix)
- [ ] `npm run build:all && npm test && npm run lint && npm run typecheck` pass
- [ ] `npm run verify` passes (package checks + README examples)
- [ ] README/docs updated if behaviour or output changed (`verify:docs` checks examples and their output)
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry under the unreleased version
